key_insight: APEX-Accounting introduces a realistic benchmark to test whether frontier AI models can perform core accounting work end-to-end, not just answer accounting questions. It measures performance on expert-authored tasks grounded in real-world files and accounting systems.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of rigorous, realistic benchmarks for evaluating AI on practical accounting workflows such as reconciliations, expense accruals, transaction posting, and report generation.
method: Built a private evaluation set of 160 accounting tasks.
Organized the benchmark into 10 distinct worlds, each with its own accounting system and related files like spreadsheets and PDFs.
Had each task authored and solved by accounting/bookkeeping experts to ensure realism and correctness.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this benchmark provides a more credible way to measure model readiness for high-stakes financial operations. It helps identify whether models can handle messy, document-heavy, workflow-based tasks that matter in real business settings.
visual_elements: A workflow diagram showing accounting tasks from input files to final reports.
A 10-world map/grid illustrating different accounting environments.
Icons for spreadsheets, PDFs, ledgers, and accounting systems.
A benchmark pipeline graphic showing expert-authored tasks and model evaluation.
paper_authors: Julien Benchek, Austin Bennett, Jasmin Kern, Ryan Stevens, Rene Sultan
